title: Settings
subtitle: Token used to talk to the Railway API.

status.undecipherable: Cannot be decrypted with the current master key

form.label: Railway token
form.noProjectTokens: Project tokens are not supported: they apply to a single environment and do not list projects.
form.tokenHint: Validated on Railway and stored encrypted. It is not shown again.

reactivate: Add a new token to reactivate the integration.
inactive: The integration is inactive: notify an administrator.
none: No token registered. Ask an administrator to add one.
removeMessage: Operations that depend on Railway stop working until a new token is added. Local projects, services and history are kept.
